ForgeCAD offline AssetPack source notice

The derived texture inputs named in manifest.json are CC0 assets:

- ambientCG Metal010 and Plastic006: https://docs.ambientcg.com/license/
- Poly Haven Studio Small 03: https://polyhaven.com/license

The downloaded source archives are kept outside the repository in the local
adoption cache. This file records the license URLs and the manifest records
the source and derived SHA-256 values. No Blender, USDC, MTLX, or arbitrary
script from the source archives is redistributed by this pack.
